    req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.bland.ai" + path, method=method, headers={"Authorization": raw, "Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode() or "{}")
